prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for First Nutrition, an official sports-supplement distributor in Jordan and Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: pick a training goal and order the right supplements on WhatsApp, cash on delivery. What leads is the goal choice. A real Olympic barbell runs across the full width of the first screen like a loaded competition bar on a chalked white platform. Four large calibrated bumper plates are the goal buttons, stencilled BULK, CUT, BUILD MUSCLE, PERFORM. BUILD MUSCLE is selected, and its stack is loaded on the bar as plates, each tagged with a real product and price: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey 50 JOD, MuscleTech Platinum Creatine 28 JOD, Scivation Xtend 30 JOD, stack total 108 JOD, with a red button 'Order this stack on WhatsApp'. Headline: 'Load your goal.' A small line: 'Official distributor · 21 brands · ISO 9001 / 22000 / 45001 · Cash on delivery across Jordan'. At the bottom edge the next section begins: 'Shop by category' tiles stamped like plate weights (Protein, Creatine, Pre-workout, Gainers).

Frame: the First Nutrition wordmark in red at top left, navigation Shop, Brands, Offers, Branches, About, a search field, a Jordan · JOD switch, an العربية language switch, and a cart.

Visual law: white and chalk-grey ground with competition red #ED312E as the only colour, used at plate scale; black only for small text and rubber plate edges. Condensed industrial stencil numerals and caps as printed on real competition plates, a sturdy grotesk for body text. Photographic knurled steel bar and rubber plates, not cartoon, not dark.
